title: MicroPulse® SignalMaster Compact Directional Warning
subtitle: Compact rear-facing directional warning that integrates with the MicroPulse system, in 4-head and 8-head Amber-only configurations.
description: The Federal Signal MicroPulse® SignalMaster delivers compact, rear-facing directional warning that integrates directly with an existing MicroPulse LED system. Available in 4-head and 8-head Amber-only configurations.
summary_bullets: MicroPulse® LED technology for maximum visibility
Compact design for rear deck or trunk lid mounting
Available in Amber, Blue, Red, and White

features: Integrates with existing MicroPulse LED system
benefits: Adds directional warning to vehicles already running MicroPulse LEDs without a separate control system
Dead-end-prevention filter logic — only valid SKU combos enabled
applications: Municipal police patrol — unmarked and low-profile units
Fire/EMS apparatus — supplemental rear traffic direction
Work-truck and utility fleets — compact traffic control
